title: Origin story: Beowulf
description: Beowulf was the Geatish warrior who sailed to Denmark to rid King Hrothgar's hall of Grendel, the night-stalking monster. He tore Grendel's arm off bare-handed, slew Grendel's mother in her mere, and fifty years later, as king, died killing the dragon that ravaged his people.
